name: Swallow Opens the Gate
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage.
surge2_html: Move 1 unit after the attack.
rider_html: If you began this Action with no Combo and hit, gain 1 additional Combo.

name: Reed Bends Before Iron
flavor:
Keep your feet when a drunk shoves you, take a thrown mug on the forearm, stand firm in a doorway while someone leans on it, or hold your footing on a rocking boat.

Not enough to stop a charging man or hold a door shut against someone your own size.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Reduce the next incoming Damage you take by 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: You also resist the next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Extend the protection to one adjacent willing ally.
rider_html: You may enter Reed Stance: while you have not moved since your last turn began, the first forced movement against you each round is reduced by 1 unit.

name: Hare Crosses the Spear
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.
effect_html: Move up to 2 units before the attack. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Increase this movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: After a hit, move 1 unit without triggering movement Reactions.
rider_html: After resolving, you may spend 1 Combo to move through one adjacent willing ally's space and stop in an empty adjacent space.

name: Stone Finds the Knee
flavor:
Kick a jammed door loose, stagger a drunk back a step, knock a crate off a cart bed, or kick a stool out from under someone.

Not enough to put a person on the floor or move anything heavier than you can lift.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and push the target 1 unit.
surge1_html: Push 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: The target's Movement is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If a hit moves the target away from an ally or from cover, gain 1 additional Combo.

name: Last Leaf Falls
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: After a hit, you may spend 2 Combo to push the target 1 unit and move into its vacated space.

name: Palm Measures the Storm
flavor:
Size up one person across a room. Spot which hand a stranger favors, catch the moment a brawler winds up, notice the guard who keeps glancing at the side door, or tell a drunk's bluster from a real threat.

Not enough to catch a lie or watch more than one person at a time.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Choose one visible enemy. Gain +1 Fortitude against its attacks until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit toward the chosen enemy.
surge2_html: One adjacent willing ally gains the same protection.
rider_html: Gain 1 Combo if you have none. Your next Prowess hit on the chosen enemy before your next turn preserves 1 Combo from loss caused by your next Core Wound.

name: Heron Splits the Reflection
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. Ignore its cover bonus if no other enemy is adjacent to you.
surge1_html: On a hit, shift 1 unit around the target without triggering its movement Reactions.
surge2_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage if no other enemy is adjacent to you.
rider_html: After a hit, gain 1 additional Combo if you attacked from a different space than on your previous Prowess Action.

name: Tiger Wakes Beneath Snow
flavor:
Work through an injury for a scene. Finish a climb on a twisted ankle, keep walking a hard road with a cracked rib, lift a beam off a trapped companion while hurt, or stay on your feet when the pain says sit down.

Not enough to mend anything. The wound is still there when the scene ends.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage. Until your next turn, ignore the Movement penalty from one Light physical Wound Condition.
surge1_html: Deal +1 Damage if you have a Core Wound.
surge2_html: On a hit, push the target 1 unit.
rider_html: If hit, you may enter Tiger Stance: while you have a Core Wound, the first Prowess hit on your turn grants 1 additional Combo; your Composure is reduced by 1.

name: Two Reeds Share the Wind
flavor: Pull a companion up onto a ledge beside you, trade places on a narrow bridge, steady a friend who slips on wet stairs, or get the two of you through a crowd together without losing each other.
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage; you or an adjacent willing ally may move 1 unit into a space adjacent to you.
surge1_html: The moving creature may swap spaces with you instead.
surge2_html: On a hit, reduce the target's next forced movement of either creature by 2 units until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you end adjacent to a willing ally, gain 1 Combo even on a miss. You may spend it when that ally is pushed before your next turn to reduce the push by 1.

name: Crane Steps Through Rain
flavor:
Cross a slick deck in a storm, run over loose scree without a stumble, pick a way across a stream on wet stones, or get through a muddy field and still reach the far gate first. Move fast over ground that slows everyone else.

Not enough to carry someone across with you or clear the ground for others.
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.
effect_html: Move up to 2 units. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
surge2_html: On a hit, move 2 units away from the target without triggering its movement Reactions.
rider_html: Spend 1 Combo after resolving to gain +1 Fortitude against the target until the start of your next turn, provided you are no longer adjacent to it.

name: Boar Breaks the Thicket
flavor:
Shoulder a stuck door open, barge through a line of people without stopping, knock one person off their feet and take their place in the doorway, or push a heavy chest across a floor in one rush.

Not enough to break a barred door or move a loaded cart.
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.
effect_html: Move up to 2 units in a straight line. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and push the target 1 unit.
surge1_html: Deal +1 Damage if you moved at least 2 units toward the target.
surge2_html: After a hit, move into the target's vacated space.
rider_html: After a hit, you may spend 1 Combo to push a different adjacent enemy 1 unit; compare this Action's Success Die to its Fortitude.

name: Monkey Steals the Threshold
flavor: Slip past a guard in a doorway and leave them on your side of it, trade places with someone on a ladder, get through a crowd by swapping spots with whoever is in the way, or take a seat before the person reaching for it.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and swap spaces with the target, if both spaces can hold their new occupants.
surge1_html: After swapping, move 1 unit without triggering the target's movement Reactions.
surge2_html: The target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: After a successful swap, gain 1 additional Combo if the target now stands beside an obstacle or another enemy.

name: Falling Petal Cuts Deep
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. The target suffers -1 Fortitude against your next Prowess attack before your next turn.
surge1_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage.
surge2_html: On a hit, move 1 unit around the target.
rider_html: After a hit, you may spend 2 Combo to extend the Fortitude penalty to the next attack by any creature instead; it still expires at your next turn.

name: Ox Closes the Mountain Pass
flavor:
Hold a doorway against one person, block a hallway so a thief cannot get past, keep hold of a runaway until the guards arrive, or stand in a gate and refuse one person through.

Not enough to hold back a crowd or stop a horse.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and prevent the target from moving through your space until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Pull the target 1 unit before dealing Damage.
surge2_html: The target cannot voluntarily move farther from you until the start of your next turn; it may burn 1 die to end this restriction.
rider_html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to enter Ox Stance: adjacent enemies treat spaces adjacent to you as difficult terrain while you remain in place.

name: Wolf Bites the Fleeing Moon
flavor:
Run down a pickpocket who bolts, stay on the heels of someone fleeing through alleys, catch a loose horse's bridle before it clears the yard, or close on anyone who turns their back and runs.

Not enough to outrun a horse at full gallop or stop a fleeing cart.
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage, or 2 if the target voluntarily moved away from you since your last turn.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit toward the target before rolling.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to follow the target up to 2 units the next time it voluntarily moves before your next turn; this follow does not trigger movement Reactions.

name: Hammer Rings the Empty Bell
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and impose -1 on the target's next Success Die before your next turn.
surge1_html: Suppress its next 1 point of cover bonus until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: The target cannot make movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you hit a creature that has declared a defensive Reaction to this Action, gain 1 additional Combo.

name: Roots Tear the Pavement
flavor:
Drag a person off a window ledge, yank a companion back from the edge of a drop, haul someone out of the shallows by their collar, or pull a runaway down and keep them there.

Not enough to move something heavier than a person or pull anyone up a cliff.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, pull the target 2 units along a clear path that ends adjacent to you, then deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage.
surge1_html: The final space may instead be any empty space adjacent to you.
surge2_html: Knock the target Prone.
rider_html: After moving the target, spend 1 Combo to move 1 unit and pull it 1 unit along with you, keeping it adjacent.

name: Pike Scatters the Reeds
flavor:
Clear two people out of a doorway, make room in a crowd for a friend to get through, shove two drunks apart before the fight starts, or force a path across a busy market stall.

Not enough to drive back a whole crowd or clear a hallway.
target_html: Up to two enemies within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, push each target 1 unit. Choose one hit target to take 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: An adjacent willing ally may move 1 unit into a vacated space.
surge2_html: One hit target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If at least one target ends farther from you, enter Pike Stance: your first Prowess Reaction against an approaching enemy before your next turn gains 1 Surge.

name: Tortoise Shelters the Candle
flavor: Put yourself between a companion and falling plaster, brace a friend on a swaying rope bridge, take a thrown bottle meant for someone else, or keep a child from being swept off their feet by a crowd.
target_html: Self or one adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 and its next forced movement by 1 unit until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit toward you.
surge2_html: Protect yourself and one adjacent willing ally instead.
rider_html: Spend 1 Combo to enter Tortoise Stance: while adjacent to the protected ally, you may take the first 1 Damage that would hit it before your next turn instead.

name: Willow Hides the Broken Branch
flavor:
Hide a limp from a watching guard, climb a wall with a wrenched shoulder, walk a market without showing you are hurt, or finish a long watch on an injured leg.

Not enough to heal anything. The wound returns when the scene ends.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn. You also reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 during that time.
surge1_html: Extend suppression to the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Until your next turn, reduce forced movement against you by 2 units.
rider_html: Enter Willow Stance: you do not lose Combo from the first Core Wound you suffer each round. The Wound and its other consequences still occur.

name: Mirror Waits for the Blade
flavor:
Watch one person and wait for your moment. Catch a card sharp's hands move, learn a guard's turn before you cross their post, find the gap in a doorman's attention, or see the shove coming before the drunk throws it.

Not enough to watch a whole room or know what someone is thinking.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Choose one visible enemy. Gain +1 Fortitude against it and ignore its cover bonus for your next Prowess attack until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit without triggering the chosen enemy's movement Reactions.
surge2_html: Gain the Fortitude bonus against all enemies instead.
rider_html: If the chosen enemy misses you before your next turn, you may spend 1 Combo to move 1 unit and give it -1 Fortitude against your next Prowess Action until the end of your next turn.

name: Dragon Knocks at Dawn
flavor:
A blow that draws every eye in the room. Smash a table so a companion can slip out the back, kick a weak door off its hinges, put a bouncer down in front of a crowd, or make enough of a scene that the guards turn toward you and away from a friend.

Not enough to clear the room or hold everyone's attention past the moment.
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage. One adjacent willing ally may move 1 unit toward the target after the attack.
surge1_html: The ally may move 2 units instead.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: After a hit, enter Dawn Stance: the first time each round you protect an adjacent ally with a Prowess Reaction, gain 1 Combo.

name: Mantis Counts the Heartbeats
flavor:
Read a person's rhythm and use it. Time a sentry's turn to the step, catch a brawler's pattern in two exchanges and stay with them, pull a dancer out of a crowd without breaking the dance, or walk a guard's beat beside them without being seen.

Not enough to know what they are thinking, only what they will do next.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and reduce the target's Fortitude by 1 against your next Prowess Action until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Pull the target 1 unit after the attack.
surge2_html: The Fortitude penalty also applies to your next Prowess Reaction against it before your next turn.
rider_html: After a hit, gain 1 additional Combo. Spend 1 Combo when the target next moves before your next turn to move 1 unit with it, keeping adjacent.

name: Falcon Threads the Spears
flavor:
Run a line through a corridor and knock two guards aside without breaking stride, cross a crowded hall and shove every mark on the way, dash a rooftop and kick two loose tiles down as you pass, or open a path through two men holding a gate.

Not enough to clear a whole hallway or stop to deal with anyone properly.
target_html: Up to two enemies encountered along a path of up to 3 units.
effect_html: Move along the path; make the same attack against each target when it is within melee Weapon Range. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain along the path.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage to one hit target.
rider_html: After resolving, spend 2 Combo to end in an empty space adjacent to either hit target without triggering movement Reactions; that space must be within 2 units.

name: Avalanche Carries the Stones
flavor:
Take a barred door off its hinges, shove a loaded cart out of a gateway, drive a bull back through a gap in the fence, or plow through a wall of men and put the one in front on the ground.

Not enough to break stone or move anything a draft team could not.
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.
effect_html: Move up to 3 units in a straight line. On success, deal 2 Bludgeoning Damage and push the target 1 unit.
surge1_html: Push 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: Knock the target Prone if it ends beside an obstacle.
rider_html: After a hit, spend 1 Combo to enter Avalanche Stance: while advancing toward an enemy, the first difficult space you enter each turn costs no extra Movement.

name: Crescent Ends the Argument
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: On a hit, move 1 unit around the target without triggering its movement Reactions.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if the target already took Damage since its last turn.
rider_html: After a hit, spend 3 Combo to prevent the target from making movement Reactions until the start of your next turn and move up to 2 units away from it.

name: Mountain Kneels to the River
flavor:
Throw a brawler across the room, flip a man over a table, toss someone into a cart bed, or put a struggling prisoner on the ground and keep them there.

Not enough to throw anyone off a roof or lift anything heavier than a person.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage, move the target to an empty space within 2 units of you and knock it Prone.
surge1_html: The target may land 1 unit farther away.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if it was already Prone or Slowed.
rider_html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to pin the target's position: until your next turn, standing from Prone costs it 2 burned dice rather than 1.

name: Embers Refuse the Night
flavor:
Keep going when a wound should stop you, and do something with it. Carry a companion out of a burning house on a broken ankle, swing a sledge through a door with a bad shoulder, or pass that grit to a friend so they can finish the climb.

Not enough to heal anything. The wound comes back when the scene ends.
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage. Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties on yourself until the start of your next turn, even on a miss.
surge1_html: An adjacent willing ally may receive the suppression instead.
surge2_html: On a hit, reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to preserve the numerical suppression through the end of your next turn. No Wound is removed or downgraded.

name: Chisel Parts the Iron Gate
flavor:
Break a padlock with one strike, split a plank shield down the middle, crack a chain link, knock the bar off a door from the wrong side, or dent a breastplate so it will not hold.

Not enough to cut through a vault door or break stone.
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and suppress 1 point of its equipment Fortitude bonus until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: An adjacent willing ally ignores the target's movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage.
rider_html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to end one ordinary defensive benefit on the target. This cannot remove a Specialty Condition, an item or a Wound.

name: Serpent Unwinds the Chain
flavor:
Slip ropes tied by someone who knew their knots, break a companion out of a net, pull a friend free of a grip on their collar, or loosen a snare before it tightens.

Not enough to break iron shackles or open a locked cell.
target_html: One adjacent enemy restraining you or a willing ally, or one enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and end one ordinary restraint maintained by that target on you or an adjacent ally.
surge1_html: The freed creature may move 1 unit without triggering the target's movement Reactions.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: After a hit, spend 1 Combo to preserve your Stance when you are next forcibly moved before your next turn, ignoring its normal movement-ending clause once.

name: Nine Banners Refuse the Wind
flavor:
Hold two companions steady on a pitching deck, brace three people against a collapsing scaffold, shelter a small group from falling rubble, or keep your party on their feet in a crowd that has turned into a stampede.

Not enough to protect a whole room or stop what is falling.
target_html: Self and up to two willing allies within 2 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Each ally may move 1 unit toward you.
surge2_html: Each protected creature also resists its next 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Spend 2 Combo to enter Banner Stance: the first protected ally damaged before your next turn may move 1 unit into an empty space adjacent to you after the Damage.

name: Broken Reed Still Holds
flavor:
Finish a day's march on a broken arm, climb out of a pit with a bad leg, keep working the oars with a wound that should have put you down, or stand a watch no one else could stand.

Not enough to mend anything. The wound is waiting when the scene ends.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress the numerical penalties of one non-Critical physical Wound Condition until the start of your next turn. Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 during that time.
surge1_html: Extend only the suppression through the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Gain +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: You may spend 1 Combo to enter Broken Reed Stance: each time you would lose Combo from a Core Wound, lose at most 1 from that entire Damage event. Injuries still apply.

name: Otter Slips Beneath the Ice
flavor:
Slide through a packed crowd without touching a shoulder, squeeze between two guards standing shoulder to shoulder in a doorway, dive through a gate as it closes, or come out the far side of a brawl untouched.

Not enough to bring anyone else through with you.
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.
effect_html: Move up to 2 units through occupied allied spaces. On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and move 1 unit after the attack.
surge1_html: You may pass through one enemy's space during the first movement, without ending there.
surge2_html: Until your next turn, the target cannot make movement Reactions against you on a hit.
rider_html: After resolving, spend 1 Combo to enter Otter Stance: standing from Prone costs you no die, but still requires your turn and room to stand.

name: Sight Picture
flavor:
Pick one face out of a crowd and keep it in sight, hit a coin on a post or an apple on a string, or put a shot into the knot of a rope at a fair. Point out one person to a friend so they see who you mean.

Not enough to track someone who has gone through a door or to hit anything moving at speed.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of the target's cover bonus.
surge2_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage.
rider_html: After resolving, establish Lock on the target without burning a die if it remains visible.

name: Walking Fire
flavor:
Put a shot at the feet of one runner so they check their stride, make one guard flinch back behind his doorpost, or hold one nervous horse where it stands. Buy a friend the breath they need to duck past.

Not enough to pin someone in place or to stop more than one person.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. The target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the Slow by 1.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If the target is Locked, the first time it voluntarily moves before your next turn, you may end Lock to reduce that movement by 1 unit.

name: Loose Angle
flavor:
Knock a lantern off a hook behind a stack of crates, hit a mark half hidden by a post, or thread a shot through the gap in a fence. Shoot the latch on a shutter that is mostly closed.

Not enough to shoot through the cover itself.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 additional point of cover bonus.
surge2_html: On a hit, push the target 1 unit sideways along a clear path.
rider_html: After resolving, you may move 1 unit while keeping a Locked target visible. This movement cannot pass through enemies.

name: Split Lane
flavor:
Snuff two candles, ring two bells, startle two crows off a fence, or drop two bottles from a shelf with one quick pair of shots. Make two lookouts flinch at once.

Not enough to hit anything much farther apart than a doorway is wide.
target_html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range and 2 units of each other.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage to one chosen target. The other hit target suffers -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: The second target may be up to 4 units from the first.
surge2_html: Deal 1 weapon Damage to the second hit target instead of the penalty.
rider_html: After resolving, you may transfer your existing Lock to either target you can still see.

name: Close the Account
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Deal +1 Damage if the target already took Damage since its last turn.
surge2_html: Ignore ordinary concealment against the target.
rider_html: After a hit, you may end Lock on the target to impose -1 Fortitude against the next ranged attack that targets it before your next turn.

name: Barricade Drill
flavor: Drop behind the bar when a bottle comes flying, get under a cart as a rockslide starts, or pull a friend down beside you when a shutter bursts in a storm. Find the one spot in a room where a thrower cannot reach you.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Move up to 1 unit into cover. Gain +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn, even if no cover is available.
surge1_html: Increase the movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: One adjacent willing ally gains the Fortitude bonus.
rider_html: After resolving, choose a visible creature within ranged Weapon Range. You may burn 1 die to establish Lock on it without leaving cover.

name: Center Mass
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. If you attacked this target with your previous Ballistics Action, ignore 1 point of cover bonus.
surge1_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target has -1 Fortitude against your next Ballistics Action until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Establish Lock after resolving. If it was already Locked, preserve that Lock through one loss of sight until the end of your next turn.

name: Find the Seam
flavor:
Shoot the hasp off a padlock, split the pin out of a hinge, put a bolt through the one gap in a boarded window, or find the soft spot in a cracked beam and knock it loose. Spot where a stranger's coat hangs wrong over a hidden blade.

Not enough to break through a vault door or a wall.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Suppress 1 point of equipment Fortitude bonus for this attack. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus as well.
surge2_html: On a hit, keep the suppressed equipment bonus unavailable against the next ranged attack before your next turn.
rider_html: After a hit on a Locked target, you may end Lock to prevent it from gaining new ordinary cover benefits against your next Ballistics Action until the start of your next turn. Solid cover still blocks targeting.

name: Moving Reference
flavor: Hit a mark from the back of a galloping horse, from a moving cart, or from a boat in a current. Shoot while running across a yard without breaking stride, or lean out of a window and still hit the sign across the street.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range after your movement.
effect_html: Move up to 2 units before rolling. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
surge2_html: Ignore cover from one low obstacle for this attack; you still need a clear path over or around it.
rider_html: After resolving, establish Lock if you ended at least 2 units from your starting space. Otherwise retain any existing Lock.

name: Keep Their Heads Down
flavor:
Keep a pair of guards ducked behind their wall while friends cross the yard, scatter two lookouts from a rooftop, or make the loudest two men in a brawl drop to the floor. Hold a pair of watchmen's whole attention on you instead of the door behind them.

Not enough to hush a tavern or stop a crowd.
target_html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range and 2 units of each other.
effect_html: On success, each target is Distracted until the start of your next turn; choose one hit target to take 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Each hit target is also Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: The next Damage dealt by one hit target's ranged Action before your next turn is reduced by 1.
rider_html: Choose one hit target. If it is Locked, you may end Lock when it next declares a ranged Action before your next turn to impose -1 on that Action's Success Die.

name: Paint the Crossing
flavor:
Hold a doorway or a narrow bridge so nobody steps through it, keep a gang from crossing a gap in an alley, or make the path between two carts a place no one wants to walk. Keep a pack of wolves off the edge of camp.

Not enough to close a street or hold back a crowd.
target_html: A line of 3 connected spaces within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, the line is difficult terrain for enemies that can detect you. This is suppressive fire, not a physical barrier.
surge1_html: Increase the line to 4 spaces.
surge2_html: One enemy currently in the line is Distracted until the start of your next turn; compare your Success Die to its Composure.
rider_html: If your Locked target voluntarily crosses the line before your next turn, you may end Lock to deal 1 weapon Damage to it. This rider resolves once.

name: Screening Burst
flavor: Cover a friend's dash across an open yard, keep the stones flying from a rooftop off someone picking a lock, or send a shot past a thrower's ear so a child gets clear. Get one person moving and keep the thrown things off them while they go.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. The target may move 1 unit and gains +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Protect a second willing creature within 2 units of the first.
rider_html: While your Lock is visible, you may end it when its target attacks a protected creature before your next turn to reduce that attack's Damage by 1.

name: Bank Shot
flavor:
Bounce a shot off a wall to hit a lever around a corner, ring a bell you cannot see from where you stand, or knock a lantern down from behind a pillar. Skip a stone off the water into a boat's hull.

Not enough to go through anything solid.
target_html: One detected enemy within ranged Weapon Range, along a clear path around one obstacle.
effect_html: Measure range along the shot's bent path. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. The shot cannot pass through solid material.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus.
surge2_html: On a hit, move the target 1 unit away from the final segment of the shot.
rider_html: After resolving, you may maintain an existing Lock along this same clear bent path until your next turn, even without direct sight.

name: Sling the Hook
flavor:
Snag a ring of keys off a hook across the room, pull a dropped pouch back from a ledge, haul a rope end over to you, or yank a lever you cannot reach. Drag one person a step toward you by their belt or collar.

Not enough to pull anything heavier than a person or to lift a load.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range, or one unattended light object within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and pull the enemy 1 unit. An unattended object instead moves up to 2 units toward you without opposition.
surge1_html: Pull 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: After hitting an enemy, you may move 1 unit toward it.
rider_html: After a hit on a Locked enemy, you may end Lock to prevent that enemy from pushing or pulling you until the start of your next turn.

name: Dust at Their Feet
flavor:
Kick up a cloud of dust or plaster to cover a getaway down an alley, shatter a sack of flour so a watcher loses sight of the door, or spray gravel so a pursuer stops to shield their eyes. Hide one person for the moment it takes them to slip away.

Not enough to fill a street or to blind anyone for long.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range beside an exposed floor or wall.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. Independently, its space provides concealment until your next turn as debris obscures the area.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit after the shot.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Your Lock ignores this card's concealment. When that target leaves the obscured space, you may transfer Lock to a visible enemy still inside it.

name: Two-Point Check
target_html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range and 3 units of each other.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage to each target.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus against one target.
surge2_html: One hit target suffers -1 Fortitude against your next Ballistics Action until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you began with Lock on one target, you may transfer it to the other after resolving. If both were hit, the transfer ignores temporary concealment.

name: Fan the Doorway
flavor:
Make a few toughs back off from a gate, scatter a pack of dogs, or clear the people out of a doorway so a friend can get through. Slow a handful of pursuers at the mouth of an alley.

Not enough to drive back a crowd or to clear a whole room.
target_html: Enemies in a cone of length 3 within your ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, each target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn. Deal 1 weapon Damage to one hit target of your choice.
surge1_html: Increase the Slow to 2.
surge2_html: Deal 1 weapon Damage to a second hit target.
rider_html: You may end Lock on a hit target to make one empty cone space difficult terrain until your next turn; creatures cannot treat that space as cover.

name: Run the Line
target_html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range, checked from your firing spaces.
effect_html: Move up to 2 units, attacking one target before and one after this movement with the same roll. On success, each takes 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Movement from this card does not trigger movement Reactions from either target.
rider_html: After resolving, preserve Lock through this movement even if briefly obscured, provided its target is visible at the end.

name: Unfinished Business
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage, or 2 if that target has no cover bonus and already took Damage since its last turn.
surge1_html: Suppress 1 point of equipment Fortitude for this attack.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: After a hit, you may end Lock on the target to prevent its next 1 unit of voluntary movement before your next turn.

name: Dead End
flavor:
Pin a runner against a wall with shots, keep a cornered thief from bolting out of the alley, or drive a stray horse into a pen and hold it there. Make one person stay put with their back to the stone.

Not enough to hold more than one person or to keep anyone pinned once you look away.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. If the target ends beside an obstacle, it is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit before rolling.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if the target cannot move directly away from you without entering an obstacle.
rider_html: After a hit on a Locked target, you may end Lock to gain +1 Fortitude against that target until the start of your next turn.

name: Curtain Call
flavor:
Drive one staggering drunk back out the door, shove a distracted guard a step away from the latch, or burst a lantern at your own feet so the smoke and dust cover you while a friend gets behind the bar. Make a loud exit people remember.

Not enough to move anyone steady on their feet or to hide more than yourself.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and push it 1 unit if it is Distracted or Slowed.
surge1_html: Increase the push by 1 unit.
surge2_html: After a hit, yourself or one willing ally within 3 units may move 1 unit into cover.
rider_html: After a hit, you may end Lock on the target to create concealment in your space until the start of your next turn.

name: Zero at Any Distance
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Move up to 1 unit before rolling. On success, deal 2 weapon Damage; ignore the penalty for firing while adjacent to an enemy.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Ignore all ordinary concealment and 1 point of cover bonus for this attack.
rider_html: After resolving, establish Lock. If it was already Locked, the next time it approaches you before your next turn you may move 1 unit away without triggering its movement Reactions.

name: Survey the Kill Box
flavor: Pick a vantage over a whole street and know every way into it, watch a bridge from a roost so nothing crosses unseen, or mark the lanes a raiding party would have to use to reach a camp. Point a friend to the same spots so they see what you see.
target_html: Self; choose a visible line of 4 spaces within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, your ranged attacks against creatures in the line ignore 1 point of cover bonus. You gain +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks from the line.
surge1_html: Bend the line once around a corner you can see.
surge2_html: An ally within 3 units gains the same attack benefit until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Establish Lock on one visible creature in the line. If it leaves the line before your next turn, you may transfer Lock to another visible creature inside it.

name: Interdiction Pattern
flavor:
Pin a group of raiders down in a ditch, stop a gang from crossing a yard, or scatter a knot of rioters and keep them from forming back up. Hold a whole patrol flat behind their wagon while friends get clear.

Not enough to hold a whole street or a full crowd.
target_html: Up to three enemies within ranged Weapon Range and a sphere of radius 1.
effect_html: On success, each takes 1 weapon Damage and is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the Slow by 1.
surge2_html: Each hit target's next ranged Action suffers -1 on its Success Die until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: You may end Lock on one hit target to prevent its movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.

name: Corridor Denial
flavor:
Close a street so no one walks it, keep a mob off a bridge, hold a long hallway against everyone coming down it, or deny a mountain pass to a band of raiders. Strip the hiding spots out of a lane so nothing in it stays hidden.

Not enough to hold more than one street or to keep it closed once you stop.
target_html: A line of 5 spaces within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, the line is difficult terrain for enemies and provides no cover bonus to creatures inside it.
surge1_html: The line may turn once at a visible corner.
surge2_html: One enemy currently in the line takes 1 weapon Damage on a successful attack against its Fortitude.
rider_html: If your Locked target voluntarily moves into or along the line before your next turn, end Lock to halt that movement after its first unit. It may burn 1 die to continue.

name: Through the Weak Point
flavor:
Shoot through a door, a shutter, a wagon canvas, or a wattle wall and hit what is behind it. Put a shot through a thin plank to trip the latch on the far side, or knock out a lamp through a paper screen.

Not enough to shoot through stone, brick, or iron.
target_html: One detected enemy within ranged Weapon Range behind light, non-solid cover.
effect_html: Ignore up to 2 points of ordinary cover bonus. On success, deal 2 weapon Damage. Solid walls still block the shot.
surge1_html: Suppress 1 point of equipment Fortitude for this attack.
surge2_html: One hit target cannot claim that particular cover source until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: After a hit, you may end Lock to let the next allied ranged attack against that target ignore 1 point of cover bonus until the start of your next turn.

name: Ricochet Relay
flavor:
Skip a shot off two walls to ring a bell at the end of a crooked hall, knock a lever and a lantern with one bounce, or send a shot around two corners of an alley to hit a mark you have never seen directly. Carry a signal down a bent tunnel with a single thrown stone.

Not enough to go through anything solid along the way.
target_html: Up to two detected enemies within ranged Weapon Range along one bent, unobstructed path.
effect_html: On success, each target takes 1 weapon Damage. Measure the full path through the first target's space to the second.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus against both targets.
surge2_html: Push one hit target 1 unit in the direction of the last path segment.
rider_html: After resolving, you may transfer existing Lock between the targets. The new target is Locked through ordinary concealment until your next turn.

name: Cut the Tether
flavor:
Cut a mooring line from the dock, shoot the rope off a hanged man before the drop, snap the chain on a gate winch, or free a snared horse from across the field. Sever the cord holding a portcullis so it falls.

Not enough to cut through a wall or a locked iron door.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range maintaining an ordinary restraint, or the exposed restraint itself.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage to an enemy and suppress one ordinary restraint it maintains until the start of your next turn. An unattended mundane tether can instead be severed without an opposed roll.
surge1_html: A freed willing creature may move 1 unit immediately.
surge2_html: End the restraint rather than suppress it, if it is nonmagical and not a Specialty effect.
rider_html: If the restraining enemy is Locked, end Lock after a hit to make it Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

name: Three-Lane Sweep
target_html: Up to three enemies within ranged Weapon Range and a cone of length 5.
effect_html: On success, each target takes 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Choose one target to ignore 1 point of cover bonus against.
surge2_html: Each hit target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: After resolving, choose a hit target. You may transfer your Lock to it; the other hit targets cannot provide it cover against your next Ballistics Action until the start of your next turn.

name: Rolling Extraction
flavor: Cover a friend's escape out of a riot, get someone out from a mob by making the nearest few duck, or clear the road ahead of a fleeing cart. Keep the heads down on a whole gang while two people run.
target_html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, each target takes 1 weapon Damage. After resolving, yourself or a willing ally within 3 units may move up to 2 units.
surge1_html: Increase the movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: The moving creature ignores movement Reactions from hit targets.
rider_html: If a hit target is Locked, you may end Lock to grant the moving creature +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.

name: Terminal Vector
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if the target is both Locked and already damaged since its last turn.
rider_html: After a hit, you may end Lock to deny the target's next ordinary damage-reduction benefit worth 1 Damage before your next turn. This does not bypass Resilience or Temporary Wounds.

name: No Safe Exit
flavor:
Keep a fugitive pinned in a shed until the watch arrives, hold one person in a doorway where they stand, or make sure the man who ducked behind the well stays there. Deny one person every way out of a yard.

Not enough to hold more than one person.
target_html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and make the target Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage.
surge2_html: The target also suffers -1 on its next ranged Success Die until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If the target is Locked, you may end Lock when it next leaves cover before your next turn: it takes 1 weapon Damage after that movement. This rider resolves once.

name: Hold the Last Sightline
flavor: Get a friend behind cover as a wall comes down, pull someone out of the path of a bolting team, or shove a child under a cart as the roof tiles start to fall. Keep watching the one you are worried about even as they vanish into the crowd, and find them again.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. The target moves up to 2 units into a space with cover, or 1 unit if no cover is available, then reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain during the movement.
surge2_html: The target also gains +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Your current Lock persists through one break in sight until the end of your next turn; if it is restored sooner, you may transfer it to a different visible creature without a burn.

name: Raking Talons
flavor:
Climb a rough stone wall with one hand free, score your mark into a doorframe, cut a rope or a strap, pry the lid off a crate, or shred a sack to get at what is inside.

Not enough to cut through a lock or scale a smooth face.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage.
surge1_html: Deal +1 Slashing Damage.
surge2_html: Move 1 unit around the target after the attack.
rider_html: Assume Hooked Talons (upkeep 0): you can climb rough surfaces at normal Movement, but must keep one hand free while climbing.

name: Dermal Plates
flavor:
Take a thrown bottle on the shoulder, shield your face from a shower of sparks, let a dog's bite close on hide instead of skin, or get an arm under a dropped beam for a moment.

Not enough to walk through fire or stop a crossbow bolt.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Reduce your next forced movement by 1 unit until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Protect an adjacent willing ally against its next Damage as well.
rider_html: Assume Plates (upkeep 0): while you have not moved since your last turn began, gain +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks.

name: Ballast Knuckles
flavor:
Shove a drunk off his stool, punch a swollen door open, hammer a tent peg into hard ground, knock a loose plank back into place, or crack a crate with one blow.

Not enough to break down a barred door or send a man across a room.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and push it 1 unit.
surge1_html: Push 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: Knock the target Prone if it ends beside an obstacle.
rider_html: Assume Ballast (upkeep 0): reduce the first forced movement against you each round by 1 unit; your normal Movement is reduced by 1.

name: Spring Tendons
flavor:
Hop a low wall, clear a narrow ditch, reach a ledge just past your fingertips, keep your feet on a slick deck, or get from a cart bed to a balcony in one bound.

Not enough to clear a stream or reach a second-storey window.
target_html: One enemy adjacent after your movement.
effect_html: Move up to 2 units before rolling. On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage.
surge1_html: Increase the movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: After a hit, move 1 unit away without triggering that target's movement Reactions.
rider_html: Assume Springs (upkeep 0): your normal Movement may cross a 1-unit gap without a check if you have a clear landing space.

name: Lateral Eyes
flavor:
Catch the pickpocket at your shoulder, spot a figure ducking behind a market stall, see the cat moving in a dark alley, or know which face in a crowd is watching you.

Not enough to see through walls or find someone who has truly gone to ground.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Detect the location of one concealed but not fully hidden enemy within 3 units; gain +1 Fortitude against that enemy until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase detection range by 2 units.
surge2_html: An adjacent willing ally gains the same defensive bonus.
rider_html: Assume Lateral Eyes (upkeep 0): ordinary visual concealment within 1 unit does not impose penalties on your attacks; solid barriers and complete invisibility still matter.

name: Clotting Membrane
flavor:
Stop a cut bleeding long enough to finish a climb, keep a gash clean in dirty water, walk through a bramble thicket without being torn up, or hide a fresh scrape from a guard's eye.

Not enough to heal the wound or close anything deep.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn. The injury remains.
surge1_html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Membrane (upkeep 0): your first entry into hazardous terrain each turn cannot add an ordinary Bleeding Condition. It still deals its Damage and other effects.

name: Serrated Jaw
flavor:
Bite through a rope or a leather strap, tear a sack open, strip the hide from a carcass, gnaw through a thin wooden bar, or drag a sled by a strap in your teeth.

Not enough to bite through iron or hold someone who is fighting to get free.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Piercing Damage. If the target is already Slowed, pull it 1 unit.
surge1_html: Deal +1 Damage.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary Poison penalty on yourself until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Serrated Jaw (upkeep 0): your first Gestalt hit each turn against a creature that is Prone can move it 1 unit toward you.

name: Vibration Whiskers
flavor:
Feel someone creeping up on you in the dark, know which door a hidden guard stands behind, find the rat under the floorboards, follow footsteps across a bridge in fog, or feel a cellar hatch open under your feet.

Not enough to tell who it is, or to feel anything that holds still.
target_html: One detected adjacent enemy.
effect_html: Ignore ordinary visual concealment for this attack. On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage.
surge1_html: Learn whether the target has a higher Fortitude or Composure.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if the target voluntarily moved since your last turn.
rider_html: Assume Whiskers (upkeep 0): you detect the occupied space of moving creatures within 2 units on the same continuous surface, but not their identity or through solid walls.

name: Pursuit Sinews
flavor:
Run down a fleeing thief in a market, keep pace with a bolting horse for the length of a street, close on a deer before it reaches the treeline, or catch a child before they reach the river.

Not enough to outrun a horse across open country.
target_html: One enemy adjacent after your movement.
effect_html: Move up to 2 units toward a creature that moved since your last turn. On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage.
surge1_html: Increase the movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: After a hit, ignore the target's movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Pursuit Sinews (upkeep 0): once on each of your turns, when you replace this Adaptation with another, move 1 unit toward a visible enemy.

name: Keratin Mantle
flavor:
Shield a companion from falling tile with your back, take a spilled kettle on your arm, hold a friend steady on a windy ledge, or catch a slammed shutter on your shoulder.

Not enough to stop a falling beam or shrug off a crossbow bolt.
target_html: Self or one adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Unopposed. Reduce the target's next incoming Damage by 1 and next forced movement by 1 unit until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: The target gains +1 Fortitude against hazards until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: You and the ally both receive the protection.
rider_html: Assume Mantle (upkeep 1): the first Damage you take each round is reduced by 1. This is prevention, not increased Resilience or removal of accumulated Damage.

name: Trauma Lattice
flavor:
Walk on a sprained ankle for the rest of the day, hold a rope with a cut hand, stand in a river current on a bad leg, or keep your grip on a ladder while the wind pulls at you.

Not enough to mend the injury or to carry anything worse than a Light Wound.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress the numerical penalties from one Light physical Wound Condition until the start of your next turn; gain +1 Fortitude against forced movement during that time.
surge1_html: Suppression lasts through the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary Slowed or Poison Condition for the same duration.
rider_html: Assume Lattice (upkeep 1): suppress one chosen Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties while this Adaptation remains. Missing structures, Critical effects and Wound spaces are unchanged.

name: Reflex Spines
flavor:
Make a grab for your purse cost a handful of bloodied fingers, keep dogs from closing on you, pin a cloak to a wall, hang a lantern or a pack from your own back, or snag a rope your hand has missed.

Not enough to hold off a crowd or get through armor.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Piercing Damage. Independently, reduce your next incoming melee Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: On a hit, push the enemy 1 unit.
surge2_html: Gain +1 Fortitude against that enemy until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Spines (upkeep 1): the first time each round an enemy voluntarily moves between two spaces adjacent to you, its movement ends in the destination space.

name: Counterweight Tail
flavor:
Swing a companion from one ledge to another, sweep a bench out of your path, set a drunk down in the corner where he will do no harm, keep your feet on a rolling deck, or walk a beam with a load on your back.

Not enough to throw someone across a room.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and move the target to another empty space adjacent to you.
surge1_html: You may move 1 unit before moving the target.
surge2_html: Knock the target Prone.
rider_html: Assume Counterweight (upkeep 0): you cannot be made Prone by ordinary terrain; other sources can still knock you Prone.

name: Hydraulic Musculature
flavor:
Shove a person clean off their feet, throw a stool across a tavern, force a stuck door open, heave a cart wheel out of a rut, or push a boat off a mud bank.

Not enough to move a loaded cart or break a vault door.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and push it 2 units.
surge1_html: Push 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if the target hits an impassable obstacle.
rider_html: Assume Hydraulics (upkeep 1): the first successful Gestalt push or pull on each of your turns moves its target 1 additional unit.

name: Rooted Mass
flavor:
Hold a door shut against someone pushing from the other side, anchor a rope while a friend climbs, stand in a river crossing where others would be swept away, keep your feet when a crowd pushes past, or brace a ladder for a climber.

Not enough to hold back a cart on a slope or anchor a boat in a current.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Reduce the next incoming Damage by 1 and resist up to 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's Movement penalty until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: An adjacent willing ally may share the forced-movement protection.
rider_html: Assume Rooted Mass (upkeep 0): while stationary, adjacent willing allies resist the first 1 unit of forced movement against them each round. You count as an ally for this benefit.

name: Adhesive Pads
flavor:
Climb a sheer wall, hang from the rafters while a patrol passes beneath you, cross a ceiling to drop behind a guard, scale a cliff face without rope, or cling to the side of a moving wagon.

Not enough to carry another person up with you.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Move up to 3 units along a wall, floor or rough ceiling, ending on a supporting surface.
surge1_html: Increase the movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: An ordinary restraint that prevents this movement is suppressed until the movement ends.
rider_html: Assume Pads (upkeep 0): climb walls at normal Movement while at least two limbs are available; a ceiling requires an extra 1 unit per space.

name: Pneumatic Leap
flavor:
Leap to a second-storey window, clear a stream, jump a fence from a standstill, cross from one rooftop to the next, or come down a flight of stairs in one bound.

Not enough to clear a river or reach a tower top.
target_html: One enemy adjacent to an empty landing space within 3 units.
effect_html: Leap to the landing space along a clear path. On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage to the target.
surge1_html: Increase leap distance by 1 unit.
surge2_html: On a hit, push the target 2 units away from your landing space.
rider_html: Assume Pneumatics (upkeep 0): your jumps ignore the first 1 unit of vertical rise, but cannot pass through solid obstacles or end unsupported.

name: Vestibular Override
flavor:
Keep your feet on a pitching deck, walk a rope or a ridge beam, come up running after a fall from a horse, shake off a blow to the head and keep moving, or stay standing when the drink says otherwise.

Not enough to walk away from a long fall.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Stand from Prone without burning a die, then move up to 2 units. Suppress ordinary dizziness or disorientation penalties during this Action.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary Movement-limiting Condition until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Override (upkeep 0): ignore the Fortitude penalty from Prone; its other effects remain.

name: Tool-Bearing Digits
flavor:
Snag a key from a hook across the cell, pluck a purse from a passing belt, fish a dropped knife out of a drain, reel a letter off a table before someone else reaches it, or pull a friend back from a ledge.

Not enough to pick a lock or lift anything heavier than a hand holds.
target_html: One adjacent enemy, or one unsecured small object within 2 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and pull a hit enemy 1 unit. An unattended object instead moves into your hand without opposition.
surge1_html: After a hit, move 1 unit around the enemy.
surge2_html: A hit enemy cannot make movement Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Digits (upkeep 0): you may hold one extra small object, but gain no additional weapon Source, Action, Reaction or item use.

name: Toxin-Filtering Gill
flavor:
Breathe in a smoke-filled hall, swim the length of a flooded tunnel, taste a drink and know it is tainted, keep a friend breathing in a mine shaft gone bad, or work a tanner's vat without retching.

Not enough to live underwater or to clear a poison already in the blood.
target_html: Self or one adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary Poison or breathing-related numerical penalty until the start of your next turn. The target also reduces its next incoming Acid Damage by 1 during that time.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit out of a cloud or liquid.
surge2_html: Protect both yourself and the ally.
rider_html: Assume Filter (upkeep 0): your first exposure each round to a harmful gas cannot apply an ordinary Poison Condition; its Damage and other effects remain.

name: Distributed Vigilance
flavor:
Keep watch on a doorway while your back is turned, know the moment someone touches your pack, catch a pickpocket's hand before it closes, sleep lightly enough that a footstep wakes you, or see through a street conjurer's misdirection.

Not enough to watch a whole camp or see through a real disguise.
target_html: Self; choose a visible point within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, know when a creature enters within 1 unit of the point, even in ordinary darkness; gain +1 Composure against sensory deception.
surge1_html: Increase the watched radius to 2 units.
surge2_html: Share the defensive benefit with an adjacent willing ally.
rider_html: Assume Vigilance (upkeep 0): replacing an Adaptation never blocks your awareness of detected creatures during the transformation; gain +1 Composure against distraction while transforming.

name: Mandible Lock
flavor:
Bite through a chain link, crush a padlock, sever a mooring rope, hold a struggling horse by the bridle with your jaws, or hold a man fast until the watch arrives.

Not enough to bite through a vault door or hold a bull.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 2 Piercing Damage and prevent the target from moving through your space until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Pull it 1 unit after the bite.
surge2_html: The target must burn 1 die before voluntarily moving away from you until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Mandibles (upkeep 1): your first Gestalt hit against an adjacent enemy each turn may make it Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

name: Ambush Chromatophores
flavor:
Vanish against a wall while a patrol walks past, cross a courtyard unseen in daylight, sit in a crowded room and go unnoticed, get within arm's reach of a deer in the brush, or follow someone through a market all afternoon.

Not enough to disappear on open ground with nothing to blend into.
target_html: One enemy adjacent after moving up to 2 units from concealment.
effect_html: Move up to 2 units. On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage, or 2 if you began in concealment and the target had not detected you.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain during movement.
surge2_html: After a hit, move 2 units back toward concealment without triggering its movement Reactions.
rider_html: Assume Chromatophores (upkeep 0): while stationary in existing concealment, you may remain Hidden after observing enemies, but attacking still reveals you.

name: Venom Reservoir
flavor:
Lace a blade or a drink with your own venom, put a guard dog to sleep for the night, drop a horse to its knees, or leave a thief with a numb and useless hand.

Not enough to kill outright or to poison a well.
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Piercing Damage and impose Poison: -1 on the target's next Success Die until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the penalty to -2.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Piercing Damage.
rider_html: Assume Reservoir (upkeep 1): when a creature damages you with a bite or similar bodily melee attack, it becomes Slowed 1 until its next turn ends; no more than once per creature per round.

name: Impact Honeycomb
flavor:
Shield a companion under a collapsing roof, stand with a friend in a stampede, hold two people steady in a flood, take a cart's impact for someone who did not see it coming, or walk through a hailstorm with a child under your arm.

Not enough to live through a building coming down on you.
target_html: Self and one adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 and resists its next 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: The ally may move 1 unit toward you.
surge2_html: One protected target reduces that Damage by 1 more.
rider_html: Assume Honeycomb (upkeep 1): once each round, reduce 1 incoming Damage to an adjacent ally by taking that 1 Damage yourself instead; resolve it against your accumulated Damage normally.

name: Emergency Scaffolding
flavor:
Walk on a broken leg long enough to get out of the mine, carry a wounded friend on cracked ribs, climb with a crushed hand, or keep working through a wound that would drop anyone else.

Not enough to heal anything, or to ignore a Critical injury.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one non-Critical physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn; reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 during that time.
surge1_html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress one additional Light physical Wound Condition for the same duration.
rider_html: Assume Scaffolding (upkeep 1): maintain suppression of one non-Critical physical Wound's numerical penalties; your Movement is reduced by 1. All injuries remain recorded.

name: Ablative Sheath
flavor:
Walk into a burning house to pull someone out, sleep in the snow without a fire, reach into a forge, handle a tanner's acid barehanded, or find which wall a fire is burning behind.

Not enough to stand in a bonfire or walk through a wall of flame for long.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Choose Fire, Cold, Lightning or Acid. Reduce the next Damage of that type you take by 2 until the start of your next turn; detect its nearest visible source within 4 units.
surge1_html: You may move 1 unit away from that source.
surge2_html: Choose a second listed Damage type for the same protection.
rider_html: Assume Sheath (upkeep 1): the first Damage each round of the chosen type is reduced by 1. Choosing another type requires establishing this Adaptation again.

name: Siege Osteology
flavor:
Smash a barred door off its hinges, knock a hole in a mud-brick wall, batter a portcullis loose, break a cart axle, or shatter a stone trough.

Not enough to bring down a tower wall or a keep's gate.
target_html: One adjacent enemy or unattended mundane barrier.
effect_html: On success, deal 2 Bludgeoning Damage to an enemy. An unattended barrier instead takes 2 Damage without opposition.
surge1_html: After a hit, push the enemy 1 unit.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage to a barrier; against an enemy, knock it Prone instead.
rider_html: Assume Siege Frame (upkeep 1): your first push each turn can move an adjacent creature 1 unit sideways instead of directly away. Your Movement is reduced by 1.

name: Mantle of Living Stone
flavor:
Stand in a river in full flood, hold a gate shut against a crowd, let a cart roll into you and keep your feet, anchor a rope for a whole team climbing, or take a horse's kick without moving.

Not enough to stop a rockslide.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Gain +1 Fortitude and resist up to 3 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: An adjacent willing ally gains +1 Fortitude against one attack until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Stone Mantle (upkeep 1): gain +1 Fortitude while your normal Movement is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1. Ending the Adaptation ends both effects.

name: Razorwing Transit
flavor:
Glide across a chasm from the high side, drop from a tower window and land unhurt, skim over a bog or a burning floor, or cut a rope as you pass it.

Not enough to fly, gain height, or carry anyone with you.
target_html: Up to two enemies adjacent to spaces along a 3-unit clear path.
effect_html: Move along the path, briefly gliding over ground hazards. On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage to each selected target. End supported.
surge1_html: Increase the path by 1 unit.
surge2_html: One hit target is pushed 1 unit away from the path.
rider_html: Assume Razorwings (upkeep 1): once on your turn, glide up to 2 units as part of normal Movement, ignoring ground terrain. You cannot hover or gain height.

name: Burrowing Palms
flavor:
Dig yourself out of a collapsed trench, come up behind a palisade, pass under a fence, pull a buried friend out of a landslide, or hide under the soil while a patrol passes.

Not enough to tunnel through stone or leave a passage others can follow.
target_html: Self; an exposed patch of loose earth within 1 unit.
effect_html: Unopposed. Move through up to 2 units of loose, unworked earth and emerge in a detected empty space. This leaves no usable tunnel and cannot pass through foundations or stone.
surge1_html: Increase the movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: On emerging, suppress one ordinary restraint on yourself until your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Burrowing Palms (upkeep 0): loose earth and rubble do not count as difficult terrain for your normal Movement.

name: Composite Hunt Form
flavor:
Track a quarry through a dark warehouse by its movement, run a wall to cut off a fleeing thief, find everyone moving in a fogbound camp, or follow a swimmer from the bank at night.

Not enough to see through walls or track something that holds still.
target_html: One enemy adjacent after your movement.
effect_html: Detect moving creatures within 2 units on your surface. Move up to 1 unit. On success, deal 2 Slashing Damage to one detected enemy.
surge1_html: Ignore ordinary concealment for the attack.
surge2_html: After a hit, move 2 units along a wall or floor.
rider_html: Assume Composite Hunt (upkeep 1): ignore ordinary concealment within 2 units and cross a 1-unit gap during normal Movement. This occupies your single Adaptation slot.

name: Autonomic Partition
flavor:
Shrug off a drugged drink long enough to walk out, hold a conversation with a knife wound, work with a snakebite until a healer is found, or keep a straight face through a branding.

Not enough to clear the poison from your blood or heal the wound.
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary Poison Condition and one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn. Gain +1 Composure against pain-based effects during that time.
surge1_html: Extend both suppressions through the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Assume Partition (upkeep 1): while you maintain this Adaptation, suppress the Composure penalty from one ordinary pain Condition and ignore the penalty from Unstable. Neither Condition is removed.
